title: Microverse Warp Coordinate Tree v2
description: Authoritative fixed warp destinations and late-game warp objects. Each reveal action explicitly selects one exact destination; stable identifiers are never selection randomness.

offline_generation.tier_assignment: Sort codes by SHA-256(seed:code:tier-rank), then apply fixed quotas.

use_capacity_policy.selection_note: Use counts are fixed selectable capacities, not probability or rarity odds. A higher source snapshot may select any lower-use action.

validation_contract.frozen_v1: Fingerprints equal the recorded production hashes.
validation_contract.bounds: Position axes are >=100 and <2000000000000; epochs are >=101 and <1000000000000.
validation_contract.uniqueness: Destination tuples/epochs are unique within each catalog.
validation_contract.fixed_actions: Every reveal row is selected by its fixed action name; directions and reusable/final cases are separate actions.
validation_contract.link_endpoint_distinctness: The current SDK provides no != or OR constraint, so link construction does not require distinct endpoints. Self-links are valid but useless and grant no additional capability. Implementations must never emulate inequality with unconstrained or free witness data.
validation_contract.sdk_constraints: Current SDK only; no SDK edits, runtime loops, branches, or modulo.
validation_contract.explicit_selection: Each reveal action name maps one-to-one to one fixed row; stable identifiers, probability weights, and range bounds are absent from selection.
validation_contract.v1_capacity: v1 maximum capacity is deterministic from the frozen Anomaly source_pool_before snapshot: >=18000 allows 10 uses, >=9001 allows 3, >=9000 allows 1. Higher snapshots may choose lower-use actions; no upper gate.
validation_contract.v2_capacity: v2 maximum capacity is deterministic from the frozen Wormhole source_pool_before snapshot: >=40000 allows 10 uses, >=31000 allows 3, >=9000 allows 1. Higher snapshots may choose lower-use actions; no upper gate. Shared Energy depletion can downgrade later extracts.

ui.scale_hint: Render maps logarithmically; stored values remain exact.
